mapper.select: SELECT user_id, hidden_widget_instance_ids::text AS hidden_widget_instance_ids, theme, density, font_scale, color_palette_preference, sidebar_collapsed, schema_version, created_at, updated_at FROM user_dashboard_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_dashboard_preference (user_id) VALUES (#{userId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update:
UPDATE user_dashboard_preference SET theme = COALESCE(#{theme}, theme), density = COALESCE(#{density}, density), font_scale = COALESCE(#{fontScale}, font_scale), color_palette_preference = COALESCE(#{colorPalettePreference}, color_palette_preference), sidebar_collapsed = COALESCE(#{sidebarCollapsed}, sidebar_collapsed), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
AND updated_at = #{expectedUpdatedAt}
UPDATE user_dashboard_preference SET hidden_widget_instance_ids = #{hiddenJson}::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE user_dashboard_preference SET theme = 'SYSTEM', density = 'NORMAL', font_scale = 1.00, color_palette_preference = 'DEFAULT', sidebar_collapsed = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
